# LEGAL REVIEW & REDLINE MEMORANDUM
**PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT**
**Matter:** Project NeuralLex — Acquisition of NeuralLex Enterprise Systems, Inc. ("Target"/"Company") by Acquirer Corp. ("Buyer")
**Deal File:** MNA-2026-6000 | **Prepared by:** Office of the Principal Legal Counsel, M&A Due Diligence & Complex Commercial Litigation

**Threshold Note:** The data room contains two parallel SPA indemnification/privacy packages (Exhibits 001–003 vs. Exhibits 007–008), which appear to be competing draft term sheets or a prior deal structure (lower basket/cap: $4.0M/$15.0M/7.5%) versus the operative structure ($7.5M/$25.0M/10.0%). This Memorandum analyzes both and flags the conflict as a diligence item requiring confirmation of the operative transaction document before signing.

---

|---|----------|--------|----------|---------------------|
